periods.summary: Botan accompanies Kikyo to Ikki's pre-final training. Although she jokes about being someone who suffered one of the fastest KOs and may not help much, she still contributes as one of the Seven Stars-level sparring partners who keeps Ikki moving before the final.

key_events.summary: Participates in Ikki's final-day sparring as repayment for his prior help.
